title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
author: Francesco Orabona
scope: Lemma A.13 and the proof through the nonnegative simplex boundary. Both identifiers refer to the same printed lemma.
statement: For integer n≥1 and real T≥1, on xᵢ≥0 with sum xᵢ=T, the product of xᵢ^xᵢ/Γ(xᵢ+1/2) is maximized at every vertex T eⱼ. Its vertex value is T^T/[Γ(T+1/2) Γ(1/2)^(n−1)].
conventions: At xᵢ=0 the numerator is 0^0=1, and h(0)=−log Γ(1/2).
All derivatives are ordinary real derivatives at strictly positive arguments. Continuity and convexity include the boundary.
All vertices attain the bound. The theorem does not assert a characterization of all equality cases.
proof_route: Identify the first and second derivatives of the real log Gamma function by the locally uniform limits of the finite Euler derivatives.

Compare the shifted inverse squares to their unit-cell integrals. Evaluate the half-line integral of (x+t)^−2 as 1/x. The Lean cell proof evaluates a primitive and applies the finite difference inequality. The printed proof uses integral Jensen.
Deduce h″≥0 at positive points and extend convexity across zero by continuity.
Take the log of the positive product on the closed simplex, use the finite sum of continuous convex coordinate functions, and apply Jensen with weights xᵢ/T.
At a vertex, the n−1 zero coordinates each contribute 1/Γ(1/2).

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.logGamma_derivatives
statements.header:
theorem logGamma_derivatives (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => Real.log (Real.Gamma z)) (logGammaSlope y) y ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun z : ℝ => Real.log (Real.Gamma z))) (logGammaCurvature y) y ∧
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 1 / (y + (k : ℝ)) ^ 2) (logGammaCurvature y)

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.midpointInvSq_ray_integral
statements.header:
theorem midpointInvSq_ray_integral :
  ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x →
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => 1 / (x + t)^2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), 1 / (x + t)^2) = 1 / x ∧
    (∑' k : ℕ, 1 / (x + (k : ℝ) + 1/2)^2) ≤
      ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), 1 / (x + t)^2

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.convexOn_exists_isGreatest_massSimplexVertex
statements.header:
theorem convexOn_exists_isGreatest_massSimplexVertex
    (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (G : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hG : ConvexOn ℝ (nonnegativeMassSimplex n T) G) :
    ∃ j : Fin n,
      IsGreatest (G '' nonnegativeMassSimplex n T) (G (massSimplexVertex T j))

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.simplexGammaProduct_le_vertex_and_value
statements.header:
theorem simplexGammaProduct_le_vertex_and_value :
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ T →
    ∀ (x : Fin n → ℝ), x ∈ nonnegativeMassSimplex n T →
      ∀ j : Fin n, massSimplexVertex T j ∈ nonnegativeMassSimplex n T ∧
        simplexGammaProduct n x ≤ simplexGammaProduct n (massSimplexVertex T j) ∧
        simplexGammaProduct n (massSimplexVertex T j) =
          T ^ T / (Real.Gamma (T + 1/2) * Real.Gamma (1/2) ^ (n - 1))
